question: Janardan Prasad has been appointed as the new Director General of the _______ in June 2023?

options.text: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Geological Survey of India (GSI)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Establishment: **GSI was established in 1851 under the British Raj, making it one of the oldest geological surveys in the world.
 
• **Primary Objective: **GSI's primary goal is to conduct geological surveys and studies of India to provide fundamental earth science information for the government, industry, and public.
 
• **Headquarters: **GSI's headquarters is located in Kolkata, West Bengal.
 
• **Regional Offices: **GSI has six regional offices located in Lucknow, Jaipur, Nagpur, Hyderabad, Shillong, and Kolkata.
 
• **Activities: GSI's activities include:**
 
 
• Ground surveys
 
• Airborne and marine surveys
 
• Mineral prospecting and investigation
 
• Multidisciplinary geoscientific studies
 
• Geotechnical studies
 
• Geo-environmental studies
 
• Natural hazards studies
 
• Glaciology
 
• Seismotectonic studies
 
• Fundamental research
